name: Client Experience Package
baselineExclusions: Legacy reporting Python compiler/validation tooling (.py files); not part of this package
promotionPolicy: Only apply the changes between this baseline and the current test source, after explicit user approval. Do not replace live source wholesale or promote existing reporting/test-only features. Preserve app-specific configuration.
features: High-contrast selected radios and labels in dark mode, including disabled read-only record views, with keyboard focus and Windows High Contrast support. Light mode and stored values unchanged.
Correct Financial Assistance table alias to cmps_financialassistances for form saves, searches, related records, migration and archive/restore; primary ID and enrollment lookup columns unchanged.
Services: Where Did You Refer - Other is in Service Details directly below Where Did You Refer; existing conditional visibility and backend column preserved.
Helpline Turnaway Reason: Services not appropriate for survivor maps to 125570004; existing values 125570000-125570003 preserved, including dropdowns with older configured options.

Services: required Yes/No radio question Was Information/Service Received Helpful? (cmps_wasinformationservicereceivedhelpful, 125570000/125570001), visible/required only for a linked REACH Center enrollment.
New Helpline records cannot select or save SV Helpline. Historical records retain their displayed/editable SV Helpline choice and backend mapping 125570005.

Program Enrollment: rename existing cmps_howdidsvclienthearaboutusreferredby field to Where was client referred from? in Enrollment Details. Preserve its original choices, backend mapping and visibility. Remove duplicate cmps_wherewasclientreferredfrom from the UI and reads/writes, including stale drafts; remove the empty SV Specific section.

Enforce existing hub-scoped Create access consistently: hide all Start/Create form buttons without a grant (including client overview, related forms, client search modal and My Work pending VOCA), reject direct start handlers before work begins, and recheck new-record saves. Resolve catalog aliases, fail closed while roles load, and preserve existing view/edit and IT Admin access behavior.

Services-only save popup: Create another service with optional Copy Service Notes (unchecked by default). After confirmed create/update, verify the same client and active enrollment, require Create permission, open a new draft with a fresh sequential ID, and copy only notes when requested. Preserve the original return destination; no other service details, IDs or audit values are copied. Failed/partial/unconfirmed saves and non-Services forms do not offer this action.

Preserve Program Enrollment detail.clientRowId separately from its hydrated CP display label. Services continuation and the save popup's Client Profile fallback use the real Dataverse lookup, not the CP-... display value. Existing field labels and genuine client-mismatch checks remain unchanged.

verification.targetedTests: Passed: dark-mode radio styling/contrast/accessibility/baseline; Financial Assistance alias/catalog/create/update checks; Services referral section/layout/visibility/persistence and REACH-only required Helpful Yes/No radio mapping; Helpline turnaway choices and new-record SV restriction with historical load/update preserved; Program Enrollment referral label/section/visibility, all original referral mappings on create/edit/reload, and no reads/writes to the retired duplicate even from stale drafts in local and connector requests
verification.productionBuild: Passed; existing large-bundle and shared Messages dynamic-import warnings remain
verification.baseline: Original pre-package runtime source baseline preserved; original main.tsx verified by SHA-256
verification.createAccessTests: Passed: actual hub Create access derivation, independent flags, current-program/role union and canonical aliases; all 13 start handlers denied before side effects; all 31 form-start buttons gated; My Work VOCA handler denied before navigation; every supported form kind rejects new saves without Create but still allows its existing update path.
verification.servicesContinuationTests: Passed: create/update continuation with notes on/off, fresh IDs and no copied service/audit data, no writes until the new draft is saved, same-client verified parent including unrelated cached client, active-enrollment failures preserve the saved record/popup, Create/preview/status/hub guards, double-click protection, background ID typing/failure/stale draft behavior, Services-only UI and checkbox reset, busy/error retry, and unchanged non-Services popup actions. Regression: real local/connector enrollment loads preserve the lookup GUID while hydrating CP-046; continuation/client popup use it (including braced GUIDs) and still reject real mismatches.

deployment: Selectively promoted and successfully published to COMPASS live (c608cce4-d72b-460b-9fb8-10d8665d46cb) on 2026-10-19; reporting/test-only features and app configuration were not promoted. See promotion-receipt.json.
